description: End-to-end moderation and lifecycle management workflow for 5G UDM subscriber data, including validation, policy review, approval, deployment, rollback, and audits.

subscriber_id.description: Unique subscriber identifier (e.g., SUPI/IMSI or internal UUID)

profile_id.description: Identifier for a specific subscriber data profile record in UDM

moderation_request_id.description: Identifier for a moderation request workflow instance

policy_id.description: Identifier of a network or data policy applied to a subscriber

change_set_id.description: Identifier for a group of proposed changes to subscriber data

audit_id.description: Identifier for an audit record associated with a moderation action

moderation_status.description: Overall lifecycle status of a moderation request

moderation_actor.description: Information about the actor performing moderation actions (human or system)

actor_id.description: User ID, service ID, or system identifier

description.description: Optional description or display name of actor

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: submit_subscription_change_for_moderation
functions.description: Create a new moderation request encapsulating proposed changes to a subscriber's UDM data.

origin_context.description: Context about where this change originated.

request_source_id.description: External request identifier or correlation ID.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or MVNO identifier, if applicable.

reason.description: High-level reason for the change (e.g., upgrade plan, policy update).

proposed_changes.description: Structured set of changes being requested for the subscriber.

subscription_profile.description: Core subscription attributes to be created or updated.

profile_id.description: Existing profile to modify; omit to create new.

operation.description: Type of change for the profile.

data.description: UDM subscription data payload to be applied.

data_networks.description: List of data network (DNN) configurations for the subscriber.

session_ambr.description: Aggregated Max Bit Rate for the session.

policy_refs.description: Policies linked to this DNN and slice.

policy_assignments.description: Top-level policy assignments or removals for the subscriber.

scope_filter.description: Condition for when this policy applies.

validation_mode.description: Depth of validation to run as part of moderation.

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata attached to this moderation request.

functions.returns: New moderation_request_id, initial moderation_status, and a normalized change_set_id representing the proposed changes.

functions.name: validate_subscriber_change_set
functions.description: Run syntactic, semantic, and policy validations against a proposed change set.

subscriber_context_hint.description: Optional hints about current subscriber context to optimize validation.

functions.returns: Validation result including pass/fail, list of issues by severity, and recommended remediation steps.

functions.name: run_automated_policy_review
functions.description: Evaluate a moderation request against automated policy rules to flag risks and required manual checks.

review_profiles.description: Set of automated review profiles or rule bundles to execute.

risk_thresholds.description: Category-specific thresholds that influence auto-approval decisions.

functions.returns: Automated review report including risk scores, rule hits, suggested disposition (approve/reject/manual_review).

functions.name: add_human_review_decision
functions.description: Attach a human moderator's decision and comments to a moderation request.

decision_details.description: Additional information and rationale about the decision.

risk_overrides.description: Manual overrides of specific risk flags.

path.description: JSON pointer path to the field needing change.

next_reviewer_queue.description: Optional queue to route to if escalated or changes requested.

functions.returns: Updated moderation_status, appended audit trail entry, and routing information if escalated or changes requested.

functions.name: schedule_or_apply_moderated_change
functions.description: Schedule or immediately apply an approved moderation request to UDM subscriber data.

start_time.description: UTC time when deployment can start.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone identifier if schedule is in local time.

impact_constraints.description: Constraints to limit network or subscriber impact during deployment.

rollback_strategy.description: Rollback behavior in case of partial or full failure.

max_allowed_failure_percentage.description: Threshold to trigger rollback for bulk scenarios.

functions.returns: Deployment job identifier, current deployment state (pending/deploying/deployed/failed), and associated change_set_id snapshot reference.

functions.name: get_moderation_request_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current status and key details for a moderation request.

include.description: Optional extra sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Moderation status, high-level disposition, and optional sections such as validation results, review history, and deployment details.

functions.name: retry_failed_moderation_step
functions.description: Retry a failed step within the moderation or deployment flow, with optional overrides.

override_parameters.description: Optional overrides for the step being retried.

comment.description: Reason for retry and context for audit.

functions.returns: New attempt record for the step, updated moderation_status, and reference to any new validation or deployment jobs created.

functions.name: rollback_moderated_change
functions.description: Rollback an applied moderated change for a subscriber, restoring a previous UDM state.

rollback_reason.description: Reason for triggering rollback (e.g., service degradation, misconfiguration).

functions.returns: Rollback job identifier, rollback status, and details of which subscriber profile and policies were reverted.

functions.name: cancel_moderation_request
functions.description: Cancel an in-progress moderation request before or during deployment.

force.description: If true, attempt to force cancel even during deployment windows.

notify_channels.description: Channels to inform about this cancellation.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation, updated moderation_status=cancelled, and audit record reference.

functions.name: list_moderation_requests
functions.description: Search and list moderation requests using flexible filters for reporting or dashboards.

filters.description: Filter criteria for listing moderation requests.

functions.returns: Paginated list of moderation requests with summary fields (id, subscriber_id, status, risk, timestamps, origin).

functions.name: get_subscriber_profile_moderation_view
functions.description: Retrieve a consolidated view of a subscriber's current UDM profile and any active or recent moderation requests.

include_history.description: If true, include recent moderation history and audit summaries.

history_limit.description: Maximum number of historical moderation items to return.

view_options.description: Options to control level of detail in profile view.

functions.returns: Composite view including current UDM subscription profile, effective policies, and optionally recent moderation and audit summaries.

functions.name: record_moderation_audit_event
functions.description: Record a custom audit event associated with a moderation request or subscriber for compliance and traceability.

context.description: Context linking this audit event to entities.

details.description: Structured key-value details for the event.

functions.returns: New audit_id created for the event and a timestamp of when the event was recorded.

functions.name: get_moderation_audit_trail
functions.description: Retrieve the ordered audit trail of moderation actions and events for a moderation request or subscriber.

subscriber_id.description: Alternative to moderation_request_id; at least one must be provided.

functions.returns: Chronologically ordered list of audit events matching the filters, with pagination cursor for subsequent retrieval.

functions.name: search_udm_moderation_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across udm_moderation entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching udm_moderation entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_udm_moderation_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N udm_moderation records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_udm_moderation_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many udm_moderation records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_udm_moderation_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many udm_moderation records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_udm_moderation_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of udm_moderation data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_udm_moderation_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a udm_moderation dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_udm_moderation_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more udm_moderation entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_udm_moderation_snapshot
functions.description: Restore udm_moderation state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_udm_moderation_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the udm_moderation workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_udm_moderation_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across udm_moderation metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_udm_moderation_audit_events
functions.description: Search the udm_moderation audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_udm_moderation_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers udm_moderation workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_udm_moderation_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for udm_moderation events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_udm_moderation_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for udm_moderation events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_udm_moderation_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off udm_moderation job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_udm_moderation_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled udm_moderation jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_udm_moderation_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled udm_moderation job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_udm_moderation_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a udm_moderation operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_udm_moderation_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a udm_moderation action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_udm_moderation_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a udm_moderation approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_udm_moderation_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any udm_moderation entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_udm_moderation_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a udm_moderation entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_udm_moderation_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling udm_moderation behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_udm_moderation_policies
functions.description: List udm_moderation policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_udm_moderation_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two udm_moderation-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_udm_moderation_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a udm_moderation entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_udm_moderation_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many udm_moderation entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
